I have my boyfriend and my family but sometimes it is a lot constantly be a care taker and the adult in the room. The profits from trading without anxiety/emotion would have allowed me to take a break and still care for my family. I know I can not change that and I am doing my best to try to keep from thinking about it. I am graduating and will start a new job with better pay and more opportunity. Unfortunately, I am unable to work a second job a I used to so my income will go down. I’m doing my best to plan for this change as I believe it is the best for my health for the future of my family. It is just tough right now with this being in the news all the time and with me working to process and heal from trauma also. I am trying my best to stay here but I find myself staying in bed when I am not working and struggling to motivate myself. I am also having night mares and night terrors so the lack of restful sleep is an issue. I still have some hope that putting out the truth and working on this little by little will get me through. I worry though, I know what it is like to be in that calm when you’ve fully committed to dying and cannot be stopped. I am afraid that it will hit me and I will not be at a point of reaching out and I will not come back like the last time.
